content.short: OttoBots offers purpose-driven bots to empower the Web3 community, free to use.
content.description: The daily influx of new tokens presents both promise and risk: while some projects offer potential gains, a large share end up being scams or rug pulls. For investors and snipers, distinguishing legitimate tokens from scams can be a difficult and costly challenge, often resulting in losses. OttoBots builds purpose-driven bots to support the Web3 community by providing a free, accessible solution to evaluate projects before committing funds. These tools operate under the motto Bots With Benefits, delivering practical insights that help identify trustworthy opportunities without the usual cost.
